summary: The Flysurfer Sonic 5 is a groundbreaking closed-cell foil kite designed for big air. Combining ram-air efficiency with water relaunchability, it delivers massive hangtime and unique boosting characteristics unlike any LEI kite.
best_for: Big air riders wanting the unique boost and hangtime of a foil kite

structured_review.summary: A light-wind foil kite with exceptional upwind drive, lift and hangtime; once Jason learned its timing, it clearly outjumped a 15m Juice D/LAB in 15–20 knots. It is slow and heavy compared with an LEI and unforgiving in rain, gusty spots or sub-12-knot lulls, where it can be hard to relaunch. Setup and bridle tangles add hassle.
pros: Huge lift and hangtime; 1–4 extra seconds per jump versus an LEI
Exceptional upwind performance in light wind
Holds its shape and resists wingtip folds
Rides in lulls where similar-sized LEI riders stall
Jumps get higher more consistently once timing is learned
cons: Much heavier bar and steering pressure, and far slower than an LEI
Hard or impossible to relaunch once wet below about 12 knots
Gusty spots, offshore land wind and rain sharply raise the risk
Steep learning curve for jumps, heli loops and landings
structured_review.best_for: Experienced twin-tip riders with clean, steady wind and safe launches who want maximum light-wind boost and hangtime.
structured_review.not_for: Riders at gusty, crowded or debris-strewn spots, or anyone wanting simple water relaunch.
structured_review.rec_blurb: Light-wind hangtime monster, once you earn it.
